note: Independent source rejudgment against committed source b4215935acd576856c4ddfb9160d1d67a6860fd8 after concurrent commit cd0b42213c added TestForwardWithdrawalDoesNotCreateASPath and its native discrimination record. No unrelated working-tree checker edits were included. RFC 4271 Section 5.1.2(b): "When a given BGP speaker advertises the route to an external peer, the advertising speaker updates the AS_PATH attribute as follows:" The following three cases require a local-AS prepend to a leading AS_SEQUENCE, a new leading AS_SEQUENCE before AS_SET, or creation of an AS_SEQUENCE for an empty path, with a new segment recommended on overflow. Section 4.3 separately states: "An UPDATE message might advertise only routes that are to be withdrawn from service, in which case the message will not include path attributes or Network Layer Reachability Information." The existing positive tests cover the actual established announce path with an explicit leading sequence; the ASPathEdit leading-AS_SET and full-255-member sequence branches; and present zero-length AS_PATH through cached and route-server forwarding at both negotiated ASN widths. TestForwardPresentEmptyASPath requires exactly one output, unchanged NLRI and the exact one-member local-AS sequence for an ordinary external recipient, with internal/route-server controls and received-input immutability. TestASPathSlotPrependOnlyWhenAdvertising uses the same prepend intent for advertisement and withdrawal, requires the precise prepended AS-number sequence for the former and no AS_PATH operation for attribute-free withdrawal or MP_UNREACH-only input. The established iBGP control keeps the decoded AS-number list unchanged. Existing limits remain: that iBGP control compares decoded numbers rather than exact TLV bytes, and the overflow test checks the new local-AS segment and retained-segment member count rather than every retained member value. The unchanged checkRelayWithdrawalShape adds independent FRR decoded-path, withdrawal-decode, no-attribute-error and live-session observations, with prior route arrival preceding absence; no fresh interop run is claimed here. The added cd0b42213c test strengthens the negative at actual ForwardUpdate dispatch: forwardOneBody captures exactly one rebuilt raw body from one selected destination; the withdrawal subtest requires absent AS_PATH, complete byte equality and unchanged source input. Its paired advertisement control compares the complete expected UPDATE body, including local AS65000 before source AS65001, next-hop-self192.0.2.1 and unchanged NLRI, and independently checks source immutability. A blanket disabled prepend or next-hop rewrite therefore cannot satisfy that control. The test inspects the dispatched body; this judgment does not extend it into an additional socket-delivery claim. Producing paths were read: ASPathEdit.Record sends non-advertising input to recordWithdrawOnly; recordPrepend/tryShift and ASPath.Prepend implement the sequence, set and empty-path rewrites; forward_build.planAttr independently refuses creation of an absent attribute when advertiseGate is false. The new paired mutation names exactly the two guards that would otherwise mask each other, while each standalone guard can protect the withdrawal. cd0b42213c changes no production source or previous assertion: it adds the bounded negative carrier and proof metadata. The row remains enforced with the stated existing limits. This is source rejudgment only; no new test, guest, paired-mutation, solo-mutation or interop observation is claimed.
